description: A post P at (2000000, 2000000) and a wall drawn along x + y = 4000001, out across the south wall - so the level breaks Core 5.3 and is planarized. The wall touches P's pixel only at its corner (2000000.5, 2000000.5); both coordinates of P are even, so its pixel includes its edges and corners: the wall passes through it and is routed through P and split there, as well as at the south wall.
